notes: 2026-10-17: canvas copy == local copy; renders in headless with the same dc-runtime (no errors). Only outlier: ~5,500 DOM nodes at load (all 267 entries) vs <100 on other boards. title: Live encounter tracker on the Adversaries tab
description: Build a live encounter tracker on the Adversaries page (Adversaries.dc.html). Needs: add adversaries from the catalogue into an encounter; per-adversary HP and Stress tracking; conditions (Distracted, Vulnerable, Hidden, Restrained, etc.) with clear buttons; spotlight / GM turn order notes; link to battle-point budget from Sessions prep. Hope-feature hooks waiting on this: Bard Make a Scene (target Distracted, -2 Difficulty), Brawler Square Up (target Vulnerable), Ranger Hold Them Off (apply roll to 2 more adversaries), Wizard Not This Time (adversary rerolls attack/damage). Party.dc.html currently only shows reminders for these. GM Fear is stored per campaign in localStorage dh.<campaignKey>.fear (0-12) and dashboards listen for changes. Note dh-kws: Adversaries page renders blank in the user's canvas runtime; user will handle in the terminal version.
